phase: SFC Mac USB identity check after FNK0099 enumeration failures
method: User moved the same reported SFC/controller cable from FNK0099 to Mac with all buttons released. Compared Mac USB registry before and after connection and read only standard USB/HID attributes; no input report capture or firmware modification.

usb.speed_basis: macOS Device Speed value 0, mapped to kUSBDeviceSpeedLow by the local Apple USB.h SDK definition.

interpretation.target_selection: VID/PID 1209:d004, IF1, HID Boot subclass, keyboard protocol
interpretation.controller_firmware_revision: not established; bcdDevice is a USB device release field, not proof of the application firmware revision
interpretation.scope: Mac recognition confirms USB enumeration in this Mac/cable connection. It does not establish FNK0099 compatibility, physical integrity under all conditions, identical controller firmware, or identical button assignments.

privacy: Only selected standard USB/HID attributes and descriptor hashes. Raw registries, USB strings, serial numbers, registry/location identifiers, home paths and actual UART port remain untracked.
